title: Management information systems analyst
_note: Technical round built from the Management information systems analyst tasks in content/reference/occupations.json, which the team wrote from the eMASCO title (emasco.mohr.gov.my/masco/2511-01) and has not yet checked against the eMASCO task list. Behavioural round: behavioural.json. Rubric format: content/interview/sets.ts.

questions.text: A manager says the current system doesn't give them the information they need. How would you find out what is missing?
questions.why: MIS analysts start from the decision a manager needs to make.
questions.source: 2511-01 task 1 (content/reference/occupations.json): Find out what information managers need and how the current system provides it. Task written by the team from the eMASCO title; not yet checked against the eMASCO task list.

keyPoints.point: ask what decisions they need to make
study how the current system works

questions.text: How do you write requirements for a change to an information system so that developers build the right thing?
questions.why: unclear requirements cost the most to fix later.
questions.source: 2511-01 task 2 (content/reference/occupations.json): Write requirements and design changes to information systems. Task written by the team from the eMASCO title; not yet checked against the eMASCO task list.

keyPoints.point: show the design with diagrams or mock-ups

questions.text: Tell us about a report or dashboard you produced from business data. How did you make sure the numbers were right?
questions.why: a wrong number in a management report leads to a wrong decision.
questions.source: 2511-01 task 3 (content/reference/occupations.json): Produce reports and dashboards from business data. Task written by the team from the eMASCO title; not yet checked against the eMASCO task list.

keyPoints.point: know where the data comes from
